tests.name: json_pointer_self_assign_slash
tests.intent: Verify that json_pointer::operator/= correctly appends tokens when given itself as an argument.

tests.name: patch_inplace_self
tests.intent: Verify that patch_inplace successfully applies a patch when the patch object is the json document itself.

tests.name: json_pointer_chained_self_slash
tests.intent: Verify chained self-assignment using operator/= multiple times on the same json_pointer.

tests.name: patch_inplace_nested_patch
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace when the patch is a sub-element inside the target document.

tests.name: json_pointer_empty_self_slash
tests.intent: Verify that an empty json_pointer self-appending via operator/= behaves correctly.

tests.name: patch_inplace_replacement_self
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace self-application with a replace operation.

tests.name: json_pointer_comparison_after_self_append
tests.intent: Compare a json_pointer appended to itself against expected manual construction.

tests.name: patch_inplace_multiple_operations_self
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace with multiple patch operations where the document is the patch.

tests.name: json_pointer_mixed_append_and_self
tests.intent: Verify mixing normal json_pointer appending with self-appending.

tests.name: patch_inplace_empty_array_self
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace on an empty array patch applied to itself.

tests.name: json_pointer_self_slash_string_literal
tests.intent: Combine string literal append and self append on json_pointer.

tests.name: patch_inplace_invalid_json_patch_self
tests.intent: Verify exception safety when patching self with an invalid patch structure.

tests.name: json_pointer_nested_indices_self
tests.intent: Test self-appending a json_pointer containing array indices.

tests.name: patch_inplace_remove_operation_self
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace behavior when a remove patch structure is applied to itself.

tests.name: json_pointer_multiple_distinct_self
tests.intent: Self-append multiple different pointers sequentially.

tests.name: patch_inplace_copy_operation_self
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace using a copy operation patch applied to itself.

tests.name: json_pointer_escaped_tokens_self
tests.intent: Verify self-appending json_pointer with escaped path tokens (~0 and ~1).

tests.name: patch_inplace_test_operation_self
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace using a test operation patch applied to itself.

tests.name: json_pointer_constructor_copy_vs_self_slash
tests.intent: Verify that self-appending produces the same token result as constructing from a combined string representation.

tests.name: patch_inplace_nested_deep_self
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace when the patch is deeply nested inside another object within the same document.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Verify self-appending json_pointer using operator/= via a reference alias to exercise &ptr == this and json_pointer(ptr).

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace when the patch is nested inside the document and JSON_DIAGNOSTICS is enabled, traversing m_parent pointers to detect self-aliasing.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Verify self-appending a json_pointer directly with itself inside an expression or function call wrapper to hit the branch for &ptr == this.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace on a deeply nested patch object inside the document under JSON_DIAGNOSTICS to thoroughly walk multiple m_parent levels.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Verify self-appending empty json_pointer onto itself via a reference alias to ensure operator/= handles empty reference tokens correctly when &ptr == this.
